info.title: Subject Advisors multi-role account API
info.description: Additive account contract. Roles are explicit database grants; availableRoles is their verified-email-eligible subset. appRole/profileState/landingPath remain default-view compatibility fields. UI navigation never grants API access.

200.description: Active account with at least one eligible explicitly granted role. No-store response.

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked Clerk session

403.description: Unassigned or suspended account, unverified primary email, or no domain-eligible granted role

503.description: Identity, role store, migration or provider unavailable; access fails closed

post.summary: Initialize a new eligible student only
post.description: Empty body only. A verified graduate.utm.my primary email can create STUDENT access once; a pending administrator invitation for the verified email is redeemed first. Existing role grants and suspension are preserved. A verified @utm.my or @gmail.com email with no account and no invitation gets 403 ROLE_PENDING and nothing is created; a System Administrator then gives the role (S3-P004-036). This endpoint never grants staff roles by itself.

403.description: Registration or account access denied, or ROLE_PENDING: staff signed up and wait for a System Administrator to give a role
